reviewType: G0 interaction boundary and helper reuse report contract

contract.requestScopedInteractionBounds: Each G0 requestId maps to startSequence/endSequence boundaries; IDs must match exactly, bounds are safe nonnegative integers no greater than Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, requestIds are listed by ascending startSequence, and ranges cannot overlap.
contract.blockingProcessCalls: Each requestId retains its complete blocking process API trace within the bounded interaction interval; PASS requires empty traces and a matching zero call count.
contract.helperReuse: Each requestId records helper PID/creation identity before and after the interaction and helperLaunchCount; every observed interaction must retain the same helper PID/creation identity.
contract.gateState: Both G0 runtime gates remain planned/NOT_RUN.

limitations: Synthetic report structures validate static contracts only; they are not runtime G0 observations or evidence.
The Draft 2020-12 validator uses the host Python jsonschema package and is not repository-pinned.
This work does not execute P01-P28 behavior, helper lifecycle, rollback, performance measurements, package validation, or target-visible paste.

findings: Request ID maps require exact set equality; Node validation rejects unsafe, reversed, overlapping, or out-of-order interaction sequence ranges.
Helper PID and creation identity must remain stable both within each interaction and across every observed interaction.
Draft 2020-12 sequence fields are bounded at Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, matching the Node verifier; requestIds ordering is stated in the fixture plan.
Evidence retains PREPARATION_ONLY and does not imply runtime G0 or T05 acceptance.
